runs.answer: The product categories that sell best are office, outdoor, kitchen, and garden. The top three categories are office, outdoor, and kitchen, with sales of 2367 units, 2511 units, and 3223 units respectively, generating a total revenue of €184667.23, €163489.96, and €153563.57. These categories account for the majority of sales among completed orders.
queries: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS line_revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = "completed" GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY line_revenue DESC
